title: Grade 5 7.1
description: Learning Outcomes for Grade 5: Identify properties of 2D shapes | Identify common polygons | Recognise shape properties | Identify common 2D shapes | Identify shape properties | Identify common 3D objects | Identify angle types | Identify transformations | Identify symmetry | Classify triangles | Classify quadrilaterals | Classify angles | Describe 3D objects | Compare symmetry | Identify properties of 3D objects | Classify shapes using multiple properties | Apply symmetry concepts | Apply multiple geometry concepts

questions.question: How many sides does a triangle have?
